name: SymbianBoard
subtitle: Symbian apps on your iPhone.
description: SymbianBoard runs real Symbian apps in an emulated Nokia phone, on a home screen that feels like iOS. Built on the EKA2L1 emulator.

apps.name: SymbianBoard
apps.subtitle: Symbian apps on your iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Run Symbian apps — the phone's own Calculator, Gallery and Notes, games, and anything you install from .sis / .sisx — inside an emulated Nokia, on an iPhone-style home screen. Includes the dynarmic JIT (enable JIT in SideStore or StikDebug for full speed). Firmware is not included: install your own phone's firmware (for example a Nokia N8 .vpl package) on first launch. Built on EKA2L1, licensed under the GNU GPL v3.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Your photos appear in the Symbian Gallery, and pictures taken in Symbian apps are saved to your Photos.
privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: Songs stored on this iPhone are copied to the Symbian Music player.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Symbian camera apps can use the iPhone camera.
